title: Signage icons

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Give signage icons consistent forms and recognizable meanings because people often need to understand them quickly without reading.
strategic_value: A shared icon library can connect Helsinki’s buildings and parks while supporting accessible navigation.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section presents signage uses and a dated library count, shows icon applications and states drawing and file-production rules.
practical_value: Reuse existing signage symbols or brief a specialist with the supplied construction and delivery conventions.

content_islands.name: Signage specimens
content_islands.spec: Begin with eight large pictograms, including surveillance, assembly point, stroller, lift and a red prohibition sign.

content_islands.name: Library and use
content_islands.spec: State building/park uses, formats and the October 2022 count.

content_islands.name: Construction principles
content_islands.spec: List line ends, waves, reused elements, red prohibition circles, type and filled/outlined forms.

content_islands.name: File delivery
content_islands.spec: Specify naming examples, 120×120 mm paper size and 300 DPI.

ingredient.name: Signage icons
ingredient.role: Communicate places, services and restrictions quickly.
ingredient.application: Reuse the shared library; preserve consistent forms, square line ends, the common prohibition circle and Helsinki Grotesk Medium.
ingredient.scope: The stated 311-icon count is dated October 2022. Source delivery text says SCG once while earlier listing SVG; preserve that discrepancy rather than inventing a format.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects globally familiar icons and filled pictograms to comprehension and accessibility.
reference_purposes.Application: Examples and production instructions show how signage icons are made and delivered.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Do not round line ends; use the same red prohibition circle and Helsinki Grotesk Medium; filename rules and delivery dimensions are stated.
